function.name: get_menu
function.description: Get the restaurant's menu overview: categories and items with their ids, prices, and whether an item can be customized. Call this before answering what's available or before adding items. It is deliberately short: for an item's description, modifiers, or pairings call get_menu_item.

function.name: get_menu_item
function.description: Get one menu item's description, modifiers (with ids and prices) and suggested pairings. Call it before discussing an item's details or modifiers, and before adding an item with modifiers. Use an id from get_menu.

menu_item_id.description: The id of the menu item from get_menu

function.name: add_to_cart
function.description: Add an item to the customer's order. Use the numeric id from get_menu results for menu_item_id and modifier_ids — never guess an id. After it succeeds, state the change using the result's confirmation_text. If it returns an error, follow the error message; do not tell the caller the item was added. The result's suggest_with lists pairings you may offer once.

menu_item_id.description: The id of the menu item from get_menu

quantity.description: How many of this item, 1 to 20, defaults to 1

modifier_ids.description: Ids of any selected modifiers for this item, from get_menu

notes.description: Optional special instructions for this item

function.name: update_cart_item_quantity
function.description: Change the quantity of an item already in the cart. Use the order_item_id returned by add_to_cart or get_cart.

function.name: remove_cart_item
function.description: Remove an item from the cart entirely. Use the order_item_id returned by add_to_cart or get_cart.

function.name: get_cart
function.description: Read the cart back. Returns readback_text, which you must say to the customer exactly as written, and cart_version, which you must pass to submit_order. Call it again after any change before submitting.

function.name: submit_order
function.description: Finalize and submit the order. Only call this after get_cart, after reading its readback_text to the customer exactly as written, and after the customer clearly said yes. Pass the cart_version that get_cart returned. If it says the cart changed, call get_cart and read the order back again.

cart_version.description: The cart_version returned by the most recent get_cart

function.name: transfer_to_human
function.description: Log that this call is being handed off to a human. Call this whenever transferring the call, alongside the platform's native transfer action.

reason.description: Why the call is being transferred, for the call log
